name: Pagination
summary: Move between fixed-size pages of a list, table, or feed. Two layouts — numeric (Prev / 1 / 2 / 3 / Next, with ellipsis-collapse past 7 pages) and cursor (Prev / Page N of M / Next). The numeric layout maps to keyboard / desktop-density operator tables; the cursor layout maps to mobile and infinite-feed-but-with-page-anchors.

page.description: 1-indexed active page. The active anchor reads aria-current='page'.

pageCount.description: Total number of pages. When unknown (cursor-style APIs), pass null and use layout='cursor' with hasNext/hasPrev.

onPageChange.description: Fires with the next 1-indexed page. Receives a sentinel of -1 for prev when at page 1 (suppressed) and pageCount+1 for next at the end (suppressed).

layout.description: numeric: full numeric trail with ellipsis collapse. cursor: prev/next chevrons + 'Page N of M' label. Mobile defaults to cursor.

siblings.description: How many page anchors to render on either side of the active page before falling back to an ellipsis. siblings=1 → '1 … 4 5 6 … 12'.

boundaries.description: How many anchors to keep visible at the start and end of the trail. boundaries=1 → first + last always visible.

showFirstLast.description: When true, render '<<' and '>>' chevrons that jump to first/last page (rare; use on long admin tables).

size.description: sm: 28 px square (operator). md: 36 px square (default).

hasNext.description: Cursor-layout only. Enables/disables the next chevron when pageCount is unknown.

hasPrev.description: Cursor-layout only. Enables/disables the prev chevron when pageCount is unknown.

keyboard: Tab - move focus across pagination items
ArrowLeft - move to previous page (when the pagination has focus inside)
rules: Numeric anchors are <a> when SSR-routable, <button> when controlled in client state.
Wrap digit labels in tabular-nums (the .lumen-tnum class) so the trail does not jitter as pages advance from 1 → 10 → 100.
Disabled prev/next chevrons set aria-disabled='true' and pointer-events:none — they remain in tab order so SR users hear 'previous, dimmed, not available' rather than the affordance vanishing.

do: Default to numeric on desktop / operator surfaces; switch to cursor on mobile and any flow where the total page count is not stable.
Keep first + last always visible (boundaries=1) so users with a known target page can land in two clicks.
Lead with 'Showing N of M items' above the pagination on data-dense surfaces — pagination answers 'how do I move'; the count answers 'how much is there'.
Pair with a 'Rows per page' control (typically a Select) when the data is paginated server-side.
Use the cursor layout for activity feeds and timelines where pages aren't stable.
dont: Don't render every page anchor past 10 pages — collapse via ellipsis.
Don't render pagination without surfacing the total count somewhere on the surface — users want to know what they're moving inside.
Don't paint the active page in lime fill (accent is action, not selection). Use action.selected.bg + text.accent.
Don't disable prev at page 1 by removing the element — set aria-disabled.
Don't combine pagination with infinite scroll. Pick one model and stay with it.

changelog.note: Initial Pagination contract. Numeric + cursor layouts, siblings/boundaries collapse logic, tabular-nums for stable trail width.
